reference: Each P3 upstream polynomial is independently evaluated and integrated with a five-point Gauss-Legendre rule on its physical face. Compare the signed divergence with the change of mass from a single Euler step on every cell of a 5 by 8 mesh on [0,2.5] x [0,2], including periodic seams and a zero velocity component.
